Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform needed additional certification steps beyond what was originally scoped, and that process has taken longer than the vendor initially indicated. As a result, the delivery timeline has shifted by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team has already adjusted the internal schedule around this date, and the remaining workstreams are proceeding in parallel so that this is the only adjustment needed to the timeline. We are continuing to monitor the certification status closely to ensure no further delays arise.

Does 14 April still work well with your internal plans on your end, or are there scheduling constraints we should factor in? Please let me know if you'd like to set up a call to walk through the updated project plan in detail. We appreciate your continued partnership on this project.
